integrity: General proof uses named classical Artin/Sally theorems; standalone checker verifies one exact nonconic six-point configuration and is not used as an infinite proof. Claims are subject to later independent review.
limitations: Characteristic-zero algebraically closed fields, reducible concurrent-line configurations, and normal toric surfaces only; the nonembedding condition is sufficient for arbitrary configurations and sharp on the general locus. No claim about irreducible curves, nonnormal targets, or positive characteristic.
title: Six concurrent lines give the sharp normal-toric surface obstruction
